assertions: The response routes to the data-pipeline sub-skill for local structure/MSA/template/crop layout preflight.
The response uses scripts/validate_data_layout.py and advises running --help first.
The response states the validator only checks explicitly supplied local paths, extensions, naming/layout conventions, CSV headers/IDs, dates, and crop/config consistency.
The response states the validator never imports the package, downloads, parses-and-rewrites, filters, clusters, launches workers, starts a server, runs Kalign, or trains.
The response does not infer whether input is curated PDB vs AFDB from filename alone.
The response treats networked curation/distillation acquisition interfaces as reference-only until a human approves an acquisition and resource plan.
